mapper.insert: insert into student( student_no, account_no, consult_customer_no, student_school, student_grade, student_gender, student_etc ) values( #{studentNo}, #{accountNo}, #{consultCustomerNo}, #{studentSchool}, #{studentGrade}, #{studentGender}, #{studentEtc} )
mapper.select: select * from student s join parent_student ps on s.student_no = ps.student_no where s.account_no = #{accountNo}
mapper.update: update student set student_school = #{studentSchool}, student_grade = #{studentGrade}, student_utime = systimestamp where account_no = #{accountNo}
mapper.select:
select S.student_no as studentNo, A.account_name as studentName, S.student_school as studentSchool, S.student_grade as studentGrade,
100 as attendanceRate, 0 as unpaidAmount, '안전' as riskLevel from student S inner join account A ON S.account_no = A.account_no order by S.student_no desc

SELECT S.student_no AS studentNo, S.account_no AS accountNo, A.account_name AS studentName, A.account_phone AS studentPhone, A.account_id AS studentEmail, S.student_school AS studentSchool, S.student_grade AS studentGrade, S.student_gender AS studentGender, S.student_etc AS studentEtc,
-- DB에 아직 없는 테이블의 정보는 임시 가짜 데이터로 채웁니다. '김보호' AS guardianName, '010-9999-8888' AS guardianPhone, 'parent@test.com' AS guardianEmail, '서울시 마포구 백범로 23' AS address, 350000 AS tuition, 1 AS isPaid FROM student S INNER JOIN account A ON S.account_no = A.account_no WHERE S.student_no = #{studentNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET student_school = #{studentSchool}, student_grade = #{studentGrade}, student_gender = #{studentGender}, student_etc = #{studentEtc} -- 🚨 이전에 발견한 DB 컬럼명 오타(ect) 주의! WHERE student_no = #{studentNo}
